messages:
marie: heads-up — found a pretty bad leak in the sample-app / CLI error path: when project config is missing the stacktrace prints the resolved config object including the API key. reproducible locally.
samir: ouch. can you paste the small repro? which sample-app and which CLI version?
marie: sample-app: examples/chatbot v1.4. cli: 0.9.2. repro steps:\n```
$ export RW_API_KEY=sk-test-abc123
$ export RW_ORG=acme-inc
$ node examples/chatbot/index.js --env prod
Error: missing project config\n  at start (/app/index.js:42)\nConfig: { org: "acme-inc", project: undefined, apiKey: "sk-test-abc123" }
```\n(i'm seeing the same object printed to Sentry on staging)
olga: not good. this means anyone with Sentry access could see real keys. is this only sample-apps or could user apps hit this too?
marie: looks like any app using our client lib with `debug=true` or sending full config into `logger.error()` will print it. CLI also prints the resolved config on some validation errors.
kevin: immediate mitigation: we should redact keys in the logger by default and make the client stash safe-stringified config. long term: formal env var naming and precedence docs + a deprecation plan for old vars.
tia: agreed on redaction. proposal: SDK/CLI auto-redact these fields: ["apiKey","token","secret","privateKey"]. Also add opt-in `--expose-config` flag for local dev (explicit opt-in).
marie: i like the explicit opt-in. For naming: current mix is RW_API_KEY, RW_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY in different places. Can we settle on `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, `REDWOOD_ORG`, `REDWOOD_PROJECT` as canonical, and have SDKs accept legacy vars for 3 months with a warning?
samir: canonical names are fine. alternative idea: support per-project env prefix `REDWOOD_<ORG>_<PROJECT>_API_KEY` for multi-project CI scenarios. downside: proliferation.
olga: i don't love the proliferation. let's keep canonical vars + allow explicit CLI flags `--org`/`--project` which override envs. document precedence order: flags > project file > env > default org from token.
kevin: also need a rotation path: encourage ephemeral tokens via `rw auth login` that stores a short-lived refresh token and uses a local credential agent. For customers using long-lived keys, warn on creation and show rotation docs in console.
marie: immediate action items: 1) patch SDK logger to redact keys by default (P0), 2) CLI patch to stop printing full config and add `--expose-config` (P0), 3) docs PR that declares canonical env var names + precedence and 3-month legacy acceptance (P1), 4) product/console note about rotation UX (P2).
kevin: i'll take the CLI patch. i'll open PR and link it here. expect draft in ~2d.
samir: i'll do the SDK redaction change. quick question: how should we redact in structured logs? replace with `<redacted>` or remove the field?
tia: structured logs should keep the key present with value `<redacted>` (helps debugging without leaking). add an annotation field `redacted_fields` optionally.
olga: created a staging Sentry alert to search for `sk-` patterns and config dumps. deploy-bot: created issue RW-2345 and assigned to @kevin/@samir. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Issue RW-2345 created: "Redact API keys in logs + canonicalize env vars" https://tracker.internal/RW-2345
marie: great. also let's message support and CS with simple guidance: rotate any keys in staging that might have leaked, and put an emergency rotation script in infra playbooks.
kevin: noted. will link PR and changelog entry. thanks everyone :rocket:
